name: Lorcaserin Hydrochloride

examples.title: Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Belviq XR® in Conjunction With Lifestyle Modification for Weight Loss in Obese Adolescents,…
examples.why: Study was terminated as Eisai agreed to voluntarily withdraw Belviq XR from US market.

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Lorcaserin Hydrochloride a low score for liver concerns and a high score for heart concerns [M]. A study on the drug was stopped early because the maker agreed to voluntarily withdraw it from the United States market [4]. In total, a search found three records and one trial related to this drug [3][4].
